h: Fani-Kayode denies being recalled as Nigeria's envoy to South Africa
p: Nigeria's High Commissioner to South Africa, Femi Fani-Kayode, has rejected social media claims that he was recalled or reprimanded. He said he was in Abuja for routine consultations.
body: Nigeria's High Commissioner to South Africa, Femi Fani-Kayode, has dismissed reports on social media that the federal government had recalled or reprimanded him, describing them as completely unfounded.

Fani-Kayode made the clarification during a visit to Abuja, where he said he had been meeting officials at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs as part of routine diplomatic consultations. He said the talks focused on recent developments in South Africa and the direction of Nigeria's foreign policy on the continent.
He insisted that his presence in the capital had nothing to do with any disciplinary action.
Fani-Kayode, a former aviation minister, is a vocal supporter of President Bola Tinubu.
more: He says recall reports are untrue.
He was in Abuja for routine consultations.
He met officials at the Foreign Affairs ministry.
